rating.verdict: A straightforward, beginner-friendly creature deck that plays like a strong preconstructed deck. It has no Game Changers, tutors or combos, so it fits Bracket 2 (Core). It beats slow decks by attacking early and loses to repeated board wipes.
strengths: Simple plan: cast humans, attack every turn
Théoden turns each new human into a double strike threat
Plenty of token makers to rebuild after trades
weaknesses: Board wipes undo a lot of work
Little card draw outside Quarrel's End, Errand-Rider and Mentor of the Meek

wins: Fill the board with humans and tokens, then swing. Every human that enters gives a creature double strike, and anthems like Beregond of the Guard, Erkenbrand and Shared Animosity make the final attack lethal.
plan: Play a land each turn, then a 1- or 2-drop human (Champion of the Parish, Thraben Inspector) or a mana rock like Sol Ring or Arcane Signet.
Cast Théoden. From now on, each human you cast gives a creature double strike: point it at your biggest attacker.
Add token makers (Riders of Rohan, Forth Eorlingas!, Rally at the Hornburg, Adeline) and anthems. Attack the player with the fewest blockers.
Cast a human before combat to hand out double strike, then swing with everything. Unbreakable Formation or Boros Charm keeps your team alive through a counterattack.
keys: Whenever he or another human enters, target creature gains double strike until end of turn.
Makes a human token for each opponent every time you attack, which also triggers Théoden.
Two 2/2 hasty trample knights at once, so two double strike triggers.
As many hasty 2/2 knights as you can pay for, and it can make you the monarch.
Name Human: your humans cost 1 less, and it can hand you an extra creature each turn.
tips: Cast humans before combat, not after: double strike only lasts until end of turn.
Name "Human" for Herald's Horn and Path of Ancestry.
Commander games start at 40 life. Spread damage so no one player feels they must stop you first.
Each time Théoden returns from the command zone he costs 2 more. Protect him with Lightning Greaves or Swiftfoot Boots.
mulligan: Keep 3–4 lands with both colors, plus two cheap creatures or a mana rock. Mulligan hands with only 1 land or only 6-drops.
